feature: Use the deployed NetSuite pallet saved search as the operator balance source
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); user requested switching to the NetSuite balance to speed up pallet returns

setup.dependencies: No new packages. Use the existing Node/PostgreSQL/fast-check/c8/ESLint/TypeScript toolchain.
setup.git: No commits or branch changes; preserve unrelated workspace and production changes.
setup.isolation: Standard isolated Compose, mbbs-tests.slice and existing resource bounds; register teardown before startup and remove all disposable containers, databases, volumes and networks.
setup.deployment: Only the tested changed files over a fresh captured live image; app-only restart, active-operation preflight, hash/configuration checks and automatic rollback.
setup.netsuite: Use the existing authenticated backend connection and the user's deployed read-only script 505/deployment 1. No script re-upload, NetSuite business writes or OAuth changes.
setup.artifacts: Persist source hashes, baseline/RED/final logs, property/mutation results, release and live timing evidence.

acceptance: S1 Parse the observed customsearch503 schema by column identity, require the requested customer, and read Returnable Quantity SUM(quantity). Customer 5240 gives netBalance=13; customer 1959 gives netBalance=2.

S2 Reject wrong customer/search/version, extra grouping or columns, duplicate/missing balance columns, inconsistent row counts, multiple rows, nonnumeric/nonfinite quantities and stale/future response timestamps.
S3 A structurally valid empty report means no pallet allowance, with balanceFound=false. It does not become an upstream error or a positive entitlement. Upstream failures never become empty reports.

S4 Preserve signed and fractional report quantities; available=max(netBalance-localReserved,0). Do not invent fulfilled or returned totals from a net amount. Legacy stock and transaction balances keep their existing response semantics.

N1 Authenticated read-only GET uses the same-account RESTlet URL, existing credentials, shared request queue and timeouts. Foreign URLs and redirects must not receive credentials. HTTP errors/malformed JSON fail explicitly.

N2 Configured saved-search mode never runs the historical fulfillment aggregate, never silently falls back to that different calculation, and performs no credit-identity query when the customer has no local pallet returns.

N3 When local pallet returns exist, read qualifying credit identities before the saved-search balance. Preserve credit-ID/external-ID deduplication, linked RA partial credits, missing/deleted credit reconciliation and local reservations.
R1 Every enquiry and submission uses a fresh report. A successful prior lookup must not hide a later report failure or quota decrease.
R2 Under the existing customer lock, re-evaluate saved-search netBalance minus current local reservations. Concurrent submissions cannot exceed that allowance.
R3 Preserve operator/yard authentication, idempotency, posting gates, stock-return behavior and all affected return regressions with zero new failures.
L1 After deployment the live operator function uses saved-search source metadata and matches the current report for 5240 and 1959, less uncredited local reservations.
P1 Record before/after live timings and network request counts. No arbitrary latency SLA; the no-local-return path must omit the historical aggregate and credit-identity reads.

failureModel.risk: A changed report schema or wrong customer grants another customer's balance
failureModel.check: Strict parser contract, hostile payload cases and generated schema/identity cases.

failureModel.risk: A credit posted between independent reads releases a reservation before the base balance reflects it
failureModel.check: Credit identities must precede the report; network-order and concurrent-credit regression.

failureModel.risk: Returning the summary alone subtracts completed credits twice or releases pending RAs
failureModel.check: Direct credits, unindexed/deleted credits, local-only returns and partial RA credit tests.

failureModel.risk: Old arithmetic under the submission lock ignores the new net-balance source
failureModel.check: Real isolated database admission and competing submission tests.

failureModel.risk: Saved-search outage silently changes business semantics
failureModel.check: Freshness/failure tests reject lookup and admission without historical-query fallback.

failureModel.risk: Deployment includes other workspace changes or interrupts an executing write
failureModel.check: Captured-image overlay, exact candidate hashes, active-operation checks, rollback and health verification.

limits: The user's saved search is the requested business source. Its current result is 13 for 800909 while the physical fulfillment calculation is 12; these are intentionally different sources.
The current RESTlet returns a summary, not transaction membership. Retain the existing customer/item/status credit-evidence rules; report owners must preserve the intended credit/date/location scope.
A valid empty report grants no pallets. This refines the exploratory adapter's earlier no-result guidance for safe operator use without blocking stock-only work.
Full affected return-domain suite, not the unrelated entire application. Record existing UI harness and type diagnostics and require zero new findings.
No dependency audit needed if dependency files remain unchanged. Local tests use synthetic data and mocked network boundaries; real reads separately verify NetSuite behavior.
